summary: Connect OHS responsibilities, risk controls and review records in a five-day foundation course. Explore the outline and enrol.
lede: Occupational health and safety management helps coordinators, supervisors and operations managers connect safety duties with workplace controls. Participants practise hazard identification and risk assessment, worker consultation, prioritizing controls, and maintaining risk registers and action records; they also learn to use incident evidence and performance indicators in management review.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who coordinate or deliver workplace health and safety activities and need to connect policy, worker input, risk controls and follow-up actions.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace roles and routine work processes is useful. No coding or specialist OHS software is required for the course exercises.
